item.text: I’ll review `src/refund.ts` and report the most important bug with a fix patch.

arguments.explanation: The refund amount is returned without checking the captured amount, allowing a refund greater than the payment collected. Validate the amount before accepting the refund.
arguments.failureScenario: refund({ captured: 100 }, 150) returns { refunded: 150 }, approving a refund 50 greater than the captured payment.
arguments.title: Reject refunds exceeding the captured payment

fix.summary: Validate that the refund is finite, nonnegative, and no greater than the captured amount.
